summary: Super Hi International Holding Ltd. filed a Form 6-K notice announcing a board meeting scheduled for August 26, 2026, to consider and approve the unaudited Q2 and interim results for the period ended June 30, 2026, the publication of those results, and any interim dividend. The filing includes conference call details. This is a routine earnings and dividend announcement notice, lacking any special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, restructuring, or strategic review. No deal terms, premiums, advisors, or board recommendations beyond routine matters are disclosed.
